name: Center for AI Safety
summary: A San Francisco nonprofit founded in 2022 and led by Dan Hendrycks that works to reduce societal-scale risks from AI: technical research and benchmarks (WMDP, Humanity's Last Exam, circuit breakers), a free compute cluster for outside safety researchers, field-building (a textbook and course, conference workshops) and public advocacy (the 2023 Statement on AI Risk, a newsletter). Its lobbying arm, the CAIS Action Fund, is a separate 501(c)(4) whose gifts are not tax-deductible and which is not modelled here.
